import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd()
def write(n,v):
 s=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=json.dumps(v,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert s.returncode==0
allow=json.loads((p/'historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()); print('allow type',type(allow).__name__)
paths=allow if isinstance(allow,list) else allow.get('paths',[])
inv=[]
for name in paths:
 q=Path(name);low=name.lower()
 if any(w in low for w in ['formal','code-loop','polynexus','crown','tournament','bunkbed','hat-','r401','r402','r395/']):continue
 if q.name not in ['keyedresults.json','results.json'] or 'expanded-corpus-r' not in str(q.parent):continue
 b=q.read_bytes(); obj=json.loads(b);text=b.decode();hits=[str(i) for i in json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids'] if str(i) in text];inv.append({'path':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'hits':hits})
 if hits:print(name,text)
write('history-read-inventory.json',inv);print('history files',len(inv),'hits',[(x['path'],x['hits']) for x in inv if x['hits']])
for ident,arxiv in [('348179','2010.01655'),('348457','2010.13324'),('348915','2012.01905')]:
 write('plans/source-'+ident+'.json',{'url':'https://arxiv.org/pdf/'+arxiv,'routes':[ident],'destination':'sources/'+arxiv+'.pdf','source_identity':'Original primary manuscript arXiv '+arxiv,'purpose':'Read definitions and full conjecture/proof context for MathDB '+ident})
print('search budget', (p/'search-budget.json').read_text())
